a:r.a:t: Definition and Overview of Each Criteria
Guide Usability - How easy it is to build or iterate Guides
Sandbox Experience - Ease of testing, clarity of results
Transparency / Debug-ability - Ability to diagnose logic, gaps, failures
- # of use cases built per week
Translation Quality - Accuracy across EN, ES, PT-BR, FR, DE
Guardrail Quality - Does SK avoid exposing internal/Guru-only info
- # of violations / errors (or good/bad binary qual score)
Resolution Rate - Ability to handle top contact reasons (Subs, Login, Account Access)
Answer Quality - Correctness/completeness vs. known answers
Multi-Step Completion - Ability to follow workflows w/out escalation
Clarity of insights - Can Strava extract trends and failure points easily
Knowledge Optimization - Quality of insights into KB gaps and SOP weaknesses
Ease of Implementation - Low lift for Strava. How much handled by Gladly vs. Strava
Integration and Connectivity - Ease of connecting to internal systems (future-looking)
- Time Strava spent getting to know the platform
Vendor Support - Responsiveness, collaboration, hands-on help
Resource Availability - Feeling supported by POC team
